nom: DERMAL 16 Collagen Korean Essence Sheet Mask Variety Pack

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin, including one who describes her skin as oily, acne-prone, and mildly sensitive, report the masks left skin softer and plumper with no new issues, though one warns that using them more than twice a week can leave combination-to-oily skin greasier with occasional blemishes.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently report the masks resolve flaky, tight patches and leave skin visibly more hydrated and even without a greasy after-feel, including relief for skin dried out by winter weather or frequent travel.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report the masks even out their skin when used a couple of times a week, though one warns that using them more than twice weekly can tip combination skin toward oiliness and mild breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including some who are hypersensitive or eczema-prone, report no irritation and improved hydration or brightness, though a minority describe stinging or a mild rash from specific varieties such as the herb or snake-venom-themed sheets.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who identifies her skin as normal reports the mask fits and feels versatile, with a pleasant cooling sensation and no complaints.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s and near 50 report brighter, more youthful-looking skin with regular use, though at least one notes her wrinkles remain visually unchanged despite the improved glow.

concerns.aging: Reviewers who use the masks regularly, some over several months, report brighter, firmer, more youthful-looking skin and compliments on their appearance. At least one reviewer, however, notes no visible reduction in wrinkles or under-eye bags despite continued use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report a marked improvement, with flaky, tight patches resolving after a single mask and skin left visibly more hydrated, even, and brighter without a greasy after-feel. This holds even for skin dried out by winter weather, travel, or harsh hotel-room air.
concerns.redness: Reviewers prone to redness or red patches report the masks leave skin calmer and smoother, with some long-term users saying redness and irritation become rare or resolve entirely. However, one reviewer had a mild allergic rash from a specific snake-venom-themed variety, showing reactions can be flavor-specific rather than universal.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer who uses the masks after microneedling sessions reports they help her skin recover, supplying nutrients and easing the pain and swelling that follow the procedure.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with pregnancy-related dark patches (chloasma), using the masks on her doctor's recommendation, reports a visible difference in her pigmentation after just a single use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts, and several describe existing acne, scarring, or persistent bumps improving with regular use over weeks or months. A minority experienced the opposite, including one reviewer who broke out in whiteheads she had never had before and another who saw brief pimples appear before quickly resolving.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers say the masks feel light and non-greasy even though heavily saturated with essence, describing their skin as balanced rather than oily afterward. In contrast, one reviewer reports her face felt notably oily and slow to dry following use, and another warns that using the masks more than twice a week can push combination skin toward excess oil and breakouts.

aspects.libelle: Packaging sometimes arrives leaking or messy
Folds cling together, hard to unfold
Nose and eye cutouts run small
Sheet size runs large for smaller faces

extraits.texte: Not for me. Broke me out and made my skin ugly. Never had baby whiteheads until using this. I'll go back to my regular skin routine with that me skin was flawless. Thought this would add to the beauty. I was wondering it took away. I don't know about you guys but I felt a bit of a burn when placed on. I had to rip it off. And as I stand here and write this review more bumps appear. It's going to take me about three weeks to correct this and bring back balance.

extraits.titre: Not the best out there, not terrible
extraits.texte: I had been using the Trader Joe’s biocellulose face masks but they ran $4 a piece and I couldn’t justify that each day. I switched to these nightly because they seemed like decent quality for price and I was excited about the variety. They definitely hydrate your skin but certain ones irritated my sensitive skin, and I didn’t wake up with the same glow that I did with the TJs masks. I’ve switched to another brand at a similar price point that I like much better so I know it’s possible

extraits.titre: My favorites were the soothing "flavors" like cucumber and aloe
extraits.texte: These are very refreshing and have light scents. My favorites were the soothing "flavors" like cucumber and aloe. The "SYN-AKE" one was the one I was most afraid of.... And I ended up having a mild allergic reaction to it. Fortunately the rash on my face went away pretty quickly, but I probably won't order this variety pack again. You can also scare the pants off your friends, family, and neighbors ;)

extraits.titre: Amazing value, generous amounts of product, good for all types, good quality.
extraits.texte: Purchased these a few years ago for my sister, who loved them, and then purchased them again last month but for myself! She has oily, acne prone skin and often wears face makeup. For reference, I have very dry, sensitive, 25 year old skin with the occasional tiny or big painful zit(s). I also have redness in my cheeks (closer to my nose), dry forehead+cheeks that flake when foundation is applied even after exfoliating. I do not use face products other than Japanese red ginseng facial cleanser and the occasional dab of Cerave basic dry skin moisturizer. I'm not big on skin care, but I'd like to get into it. For months, I have been seeing sheet masks in stores, but kept passing them up. I did the math, and these come out to <60 cents each, while the ones in the stores start at about two dollars, even the ones at the big blue supermarket. So I kept passing them up with these in mind, but kept putting off buying them because I didn't want to spend 10 bucks. I also have issues with instant gratification, so I didn't want to order them. I'm glad I did. So far I have used a few and the Aloe one is my favorite. Made my skin so soft and moist. I have trouble feeling moisture in my skin, and this mask helped. I really did not like the "Herb" one. I think it's lavender? I can't remember what the ingredients said, but there is a photo of lavender on the front, and usually I like herbal face treatments, especially since lavender is my favorite herb. This one kinda stung a little after put

I’ve been eyeballing these but was skeptical because for the price they seemed too good to be true, but they had so many good reviews I went for it and I’m glad I did. The winter is not been good to my skin so far and even with daily moisturizing I was getting a lot of dry flaky patches. They are hard to see in the pics but after one mask for 15 min the dryness was 100% gone and my skin felt really soft! I also think it got rid of some redness in my cheeks. It didn’t seem to do much for the acne blemishes I have right now, but they are advertised as being more moisturizing and restorative and since I have sensitive skin the fact that the mask didn’t make the breakout worse is still a huge win in my book. I plan to use these twice a week and will absolutely order more if they all work this well. Also, I don’t know if it’s the serum that’s on these or the material they are made of but this mask definitely stayed on my face better than some other sheets I have tried. I sat down but didn’t have to hold my head back to feel like it was secure whereas with other products I usually feel like I have to be lying down to keep it on.

extraits.titre: I'd give ten stars if I could!!
extraits.texte: Came a day early!! And I love how convenient the packaging is. I tried the Vitamin C collagen mask first, and it made my face feel amazing!! It stays tacky for about 30 mins after it dries, but after that my skin felt firm, and silky. I have chloasma, and these were recommended by my OB to help reduce the dark patches and moisturize and firm my skin post partem. Even after one use I can tell a difference!! So happy with my purchase :) (I added the photo because the mask made me look like a luchadore and I really had way too much fun scaring my kids while I was wearing it. BONUS!!)

Love my face masks & this is me wearing the snake venom. I have normal skin. Mask seems larger than other makes but it makes it far more versatile for you to fit aswell as more suitable for men. I also squeezed the packet & applied the oil to my neck, chest & hands. Make the most of these! Nice cooling feeling. No strong scent. Took it off & squeezed what was left out then wiped the mask over my face 🤗 Just what I needed after a long day.
